record.bible_text: And king<WH04428> Zedekiah<WH06667> the son<WH01121> of Josiah<WH02977> reigned<WH04427><WTH8799> instead of Coniah<WH03659> the son<WH01121> of Jehoiakim<WH03079>, whom Nebuchadrezzar<WH05019> king<WH04428> of Babylon<WH0894> made king<WH04427><WTH8689> in the land<WH0776> of Judah<WH03063>.

But neither he, nor his servants<WH05650>, nor the people<WH05971> of the land<WH0776>, did hearken<WH08085><WTH8804> unto the words<WH01697> of the LORD<WH03068>, which he spake<WH01696><WTH8765> by<WH03027> the prophet<WH05030> Jeremiah<WH03414>. <RF>by...: Heb. by the hand of the prophet<Rf>

And Zedekiah<WH06667> the king<WH04428> sent<WH07971><WTH8799> Jehucal<WH03081> the son<WH01121> of Shelemiah<WH08018> and Zephaniah<WH06846> the son<WH01121> of Maaseiah<WH04641> the priest<WH03548> to the prophet<WH05030> Jeremiah<WH03414>, saying<WH0559><WTH8800>, Pray<WH06419><WTH8690> now unto the LORD<WH03068> our God<WH0430> for us.
Now Jeremiah<WH03414> came in<WH0935><WTH8804> and went out<WH03318><WTH8802> among<WH08432> the people<WH05971>: for they had not put<WH05414><WTH8804> him into prison<WH01004><WH03628>.

Then Pharaoh's<WH06547> army<WH02428> was come forth<WH03318><WTH8804> out of Egypt<WH04714>: and when the Chaldeans<WH03778> that besieged<WH06696><WTH8802> Jerusalem<WH03389> heard<WH08085><WTH8799> tidings<WH08088> of them, they departed<WH05927><WTH8735> from Jerusalem<WH03389>.
Then came the word<WH01697> of the LORD<WH03068> unto the prophet<WH05030> Jeremiah<WH03414>, saying<WH0559><WTH8800>,

Thus saith<WH0559><WTH8804> the LORD<WH03068>, the God<WH0430> of Israel<WH03478>; Thus shall ye say<WH0559><WTH8799> to the king<WH04428> of Judah<WH03063>, that sent<WH07971><WTH8802> you unto me to enquire<WH01875><WTH8800> of me; Behold, Pharaoh's<WH06547> army<WH02428>, which is come forth<WH03318><WTH8802> to help<WH05833> you, shall return<WH07725><WTH8804> to Egypt<WH04714> into their own land<WH0776>.
And the Chaldeans<WH03778> shall come again<WH07725><WTH8804>, and fight<WH03898><WTH8738> against this city<WH05892>, and take<WH03920><WTH8804> it, and burn<WH08313><WTH8804> it with fire<WH0784>.

Thus saith<WH0559><WTH8804> the LORD<WH03068>; Deceive<WH05377><WTH8686> not yourselves<WH05315>, saying<WH0559><WTH8800>, The Chaldeans<WH03778> shall surely<WH01980><WTH8800> depart<WH03212><WTH8799> from us: for they shall not depart<WH03212><WTH8799>. <RF>yourselves: Heb. your souls<Rf>

For though ye had smitten<WH05221><WTH8689> the whole army<WH02428> of the Chaldeans<WH03778> that fight<WH03898><WTH8737> against you, and there remained<WH07604><WTH8738> <FI>but<Fi> wounded<WH01856><WTH8794> men<WH0582> among them, <FI>yet<Fi>  should they rise up<WH06965><WTH8799> every man<WH0376> in his tent<WH0168>, and burn<WH08313><WTH8804> this city<WH05892> with fire<WH0784>. <RF>wounded: Heb. thrust through<Rf><CM>

And it came to pass, that when the army<WH02428> of the Chaldeans<WH03778> was broken up<WH05927><WTH8736> from Jerusalem<WH03389> for fear<WH06440> of Pharaoh's<WH06547> army<WH02428>, <RF>broken...: Heb. made to ascend<Rf>

Then Jeremiah<WH03414> went forth<WH03318><WTH8799> out of Jerusalem<WH03389> to go<WH03212><WTH8800> into the land<WH0776> of Benjamin<WH01144>, to separate<WH02505><WTH8687> himself thence in the midst<WH08432> of the people<WH05971>. <RF>separate...: or, to slip away from thence in the midst of the people<Rf>

And when he was in the gate<WH08179> of Benjamin<WH01144>, a captain<WH01167> of the ward<WH06488> <FI>was<Fi> there, whose name<WH08034> <FI>was<Fi> Irijah<WH03376>, the son<WH01121> of Shelemiah<WH08018>, the son<WH01121> of Hananiah<WH02608>; and he took<WH08610><WTH8799> Jeremiah<WH03414> the prophet<WH05030>, saying<WH0559><WTH8800>, Thou fallest away<WH05307><WTH8802> to the Chaldeans<WH03778>.

Then said<WH0559><WTH8799> Jeremiah<WH03414>, <FI>It is<Fi> false<WH08267>; I fall not away<WH05307><WTH8802> to the Chaldeans<WH03778>. But he hearkened<WH08085><WTH8804> not to him: so Irijah<WH03376> took<WH08610><WTH8799> Jeremiah<WH03414>, and brought<WH0935><WTH8686> him to the princes<WH08269>. <RF>false: Heb. falsehood, or, a lie<Rf>

Wherefore the princes<WH08269> were wroth<WH07107><WTH8799> with Jeremiah<WH03414>, and smote<WH05221><WTH8689> him, and put<WH05414><WTH8804> him in prison<WH0612> in the house<WH01004> of Jonathan<WH03083> the scribe<WH05608><WTH8802>: for they had made<WH06213><WTH8804> that the prison<WH03608>.

When Jeremiah<WH03414> was entered<WH0935><WTH8804> into the dungeon<WH01004><WH0953>, and into the cabins<WH02588>, and Jeremiah<WH03414> had remained<WH03427><WTH8799> there many<WH07227> days<WH03117>; <RF>cabins: or, cells<Rf>

Then Zedekiah<WH06667> the king<WH04428> sent<WH07971><WTH8799>, and took him out<WH03947><WTH8799>: and the king<WH04428> asked<WH07592><WTH8799> him secretly<WH05643> in his house<WH01004>, and said<WH0559><WTH8799>, Is there <FI>any<Fi> word<WH01697> from the LORD<WH03068>? And Jeremiah<WH03414> said<WH0559><WTH8799>, There is<WH03426>: for, said<WH0559><WTH8799> he, thou shalt be delivered<WH05414><WTH8735> into the hand<WH03027> of the king<WH04428> of Babylon<WH0894>.

Moreover Jeremiah<WH03414> said<WH0559><WTH8799> unto king<WH04428> Zedekiah<WH06667>, What have I offended<WH02398><WTH8804> against thee, or against thy servants<WH05650>, or against this people<WH05971>, that ye have put<WH05414><WTH8804> me in prison<WH01004><WH03608>?

Where <FI>are<Fi> now<WH0346> your prophets<WH05030> which prophesied<WH05012><WTH8738> unto you, saying<WH0559><WTH8800>, The king<WH04428> of Babylon<WH0894> shall not come<WH0935><WTH8799> against you, nor against this land<WH0776>?

Therefore hear<WH08085><WTH8798> now, I pray thee, O my lord<WH0113> the king<WH04428>: let my supplication<WH08467>, I pray thee, be accepted<WH05307><WTH8799> before<WH06440> thee; that thou cause me not to return<WH07725><WTH8686> to the house<WH01004> of Jonathan<WH03083> the scribe<WH05608><WTH8802>, lest I die<WH04191><WTH8799> there. <RF>let...: Heb. let my supplication fall<Rf>

Then Zedekiah<WH06667> the king<WH04428> commanded<WH06680><WTH8762> that they should commit<WH06485><WTH8686> Jeremiah<WH03414> into the court<WH02691> of the prison<WH04307>, and that they should give<WH05414><WTH8800> him daily<WH03117> a piece<WH03603> of bread<WH03899> out of the bakers<WH0644><WTH8802>' street<WH02351>, until all the bread<WH03899> in the city<WH05892> were spent<WH08552><WTH8800>. Thus Jeremiah<WH03414> remained<WH03427><WTH8799> in the court<WH02691> of the prison<WH04307>.<CM>
